scope: Published source inspection only; the user-installed dependency lock and actual DSH traffic were not inspected.
findings: dsh-llm-pi-ai 0.2.2-rc.1 declares pi-ai ^1.3.0 and marks sendSessionAffinityHeaders/sessionAffinityFormat as withheld from custom compatibility configuration.
The adapter requestHeaders hook receives the real per-call options.sessionId; static custom headers alone cannot generate per-session identities.
Verified pi-ai 1.3.0 generic OpenAI Chat does not send session headers by default; Responses sends session_id for its default openai session-affinity format.
pi-ai 1.3.0 Chat cache usage reads prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens, then prompt_cache_hit_tokens, then cached_tokens; it subtracts cache reads/writes from its uncached input count.
Switching protocol still requires a live DSH conversation to verify end-to-end identity propagation and HY4 cache behavior.
